results_kept.content: May 12, 2026 · For many workloads, systemd-nspawn beats Docker on leanness, simplicity, and host integration. It shines on servers and homelabs where you want isolated environments without daemon overhead. You launch a container with one command, manage it with machinectl, and run it as a systemd service. All the tools already ship with every modern Linux system.
